Letta Code agent cannot create outbound network connections from its runtime environment. The Letta Code runtime environment is securely sandboxed and restricted to allow network connections only to specific trusted endpoints (such as the Gitea instance it is integrated with). It does not support opening arbitrary outbound network connections to other non-HTTPS public network ports.

This is a built-in limitation to ensure security and prevent unintended data leaks or unauthorized external interactions. There is no configuration or script within the repository that would allow lifting this restriction.

If you need Letta Code to interact with external services, consider implementing an integration layer or proxy service that the agent can communicate with over HTTPS, and which can then make outbound connections on its behalf in a controlled manner.
